game_title: Type Sorter – Lava River Crossing Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing, a river of molten rock: the volcanologist must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Sorter: Sort falling heat shields into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing: a river of molten rock
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava River Crossing, repeat each round: Sort falling heat shields into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground. Each round, a new heat shields challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the sorted_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 100 points of heat shields by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 100, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 1 (intro tier): Type Sorter
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Type Sorter' (Week 2 slot 1), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Lava River Crossing'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how sorted_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Lava River Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 100 within 30 seconds.
